Attach the exact source theorem passage/root acceptance and the complete finite predicate scope for THIS occurrence. A stored outcome, requiresS8 flag, native type, model membership, source hash or count does not establish applicability.

All source-specific map/contact/matrix/native-profile/physical-variant completeness predicates remain explicit accepted old-computed or classification inputs. This curator checks their association and the actual producer's result; it does not regenerate those inputs or formalize geometry.

logical_composition.notation: P means current total charge of THIS same actual face is at least1; S means THIS face has an actual adjacent white-interior path<=8.
logical_composition.independent_S8: The separately accepted and actually bound conditional S8 spine gives S=>P at its explicit complete inputs. No later provider proves S8.
logical_composition.provider_rule: The exact reviewed source branch at its associated complete finite predicates gives NoS=>excluded OR P. Actual target completion excludes the excluded alternative.
logical_composition.deduction: Assume the actual face unpaid. S8 gives NoS. The exact provider branch then excludes its realized full map or contradicts unpaidness. Therefore P. No observed S8 path and no intrinsic unit is inferred from a provider flag.
logical_composition.guard: Use the same unpaid-face logic before the exact guardTRUE whole-small capacity contradiction whenever the selected-guard source proof permits a shortpath escape.
